rules.name: High Vibration & Thermal Degradation on Aged Bearing
rules.description: When vibration and temperature exceed warning thresholds and operating hours exceed 80% of rated life, infer severe bearing fatigue.

conclusion.explanation: Spindle exhibits concurrent elevated vibration and thermal buildup, coupled with remaining useful life < 20% (operating hours: 4250/5000 hrs).

rules.name: Coolant Pressure Loss Inducing Spindle Overheating
rules.description: When coolant pressure drops below warning threshold while spindle temperature is rising, infer coolant delivery failure.

conclusion.explanation: Spindle temperature elevated due to insufficient coolant pressure in circulation line.

rules.name: Critical Thermal Limit Breach
rules.description: Temperature exceeding absolute critical threshold (90°C) triggers immediate safety shutdown.

conclusion.explanation: Spindle temperature has exceeded safe operational ceiling (90°C). Seizure imminent.

rules.name: Motor Overcurrent Draw Under Load
rules.description: Current draw above warning threshold indicates excessive tool load or feed rate.

conclusion.explanation: Main servo drive is drawing excessive current (above 26A rated continuous).
